commit.subject: LU-17000 osc: Return -ESTALE for unmatched lock in osc_enqueue_base
commit.message:
LU-17000 osc: Return -ESTALE for unmatched lock in osc_enqueue_base

This patch returns -ESTALE immediately for unmatched lock
in osc_enqueue_base. Now lock 'matched' could not be dereference
if it would turn out to be stale

CoverityID: 504221 ("Dereference null return value")
Signed-off-by: Arshad Hussain <arshad.hussain@aeoncomputing.com>
Change-Id: Ib7ea06f823425334455d2d639a19567297f4563f
